# CAPSUS - Sustainable Development Consulting

CAPSUS is a mission-oriented boutique consulting firm, established in 2009, specialized in sustainability issues in the energy, environmental management and urban sectors[cite: 2]. We solve questions with grounded innovative solutions that foresee a better future for coming generations[cite: 2].

## Core Expertise
* Sustainable Urban Planning and Building Design[cite: 1]
* Environmental Studies and Assessments[cite: 1]
* Dissemination and Capacity Development on Sustainability[cite: 1]
* Design and Evaluation of Public Policies[cite: 1]

## Methodology & Approach
A bottom-up approach is taken with urban and environmental management projects, and a top-down angle with research, development, and public policy implementation projects[cite: 2]. 

## Project Portfolio
A complete, interactive database of our ~100 global projects is available at /portfolio-en.html.
